title: urandra corniculata
intro: Urandra corniculata, commonly known as the Indian snakeroot, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the management of fever. The therapeutic actions of Indian snakeroot are attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve circulation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Urandra corniculata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
